comment: The component update check is scheduled by a cron line and nothing else
remembers when it last ran, so an interval cron cannot express exactly is
refused: no line is written and the checks silently never run.
Two implementations of that one rule cannot be avoided - a static LuCI view
cannot call ucode while validating a field - so both are driven over this
isCronExpressibleInterval.test.ts runs it through the form's own check.
The refused values are all well-formed sing-box durations, which is exactly
why the old validator let them through.
